capabilities: Set separate CJK and Latin fonts per element
Apply Chinese font sizes, line spacing and first-line indents
Generate automatic heading numbering at display time
Save, switch and import/export style sets as JSON
Apply built-in templates for official documents and theses
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; heading numbering is display-only and leaves Markdown untouched; some official-document fonts are commercial and must be installed separately.
problem: Getting Word-like Chinese typography in Obsidian normally means hand-writing CSS for fonts, sizes, spacing and indents.

requires.name: Chinese official-document fonts (e.g. 方正小标宋, 仿宋_GB2312)

summary: GUI style editor that sets Chinese fonts, sizes, line spacing, indents and automatic heading numbering for notes without writing CSS.
